persona.name: Rafael Carvalho

occupation.title: Head of Product Innovation
occupation.description: Rafael leads a cross-functional team to discover, develop, and launch digital products for one of Brazil's largest conglomerates. He is responsible for fostering a culture of experimentation, aligning technical solutions with business strategy, and empowering team members to propose bold ideas.

persona.education: Rafael holds a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from the University of São Paulo and a master's in Innovation Management from Fundação Getulio Vargas. He has also completed several executive programs focused on agile methodologies and digital transformation.

openness.description: Regularly proposes creative strategies, embraces new technologies, and encourages experimentation.

conscientiousness.description: Sets clear milestones and follows through on commitments, balancing creativity with structured planning.

extraversion.description: Energizes the team in meetings, actively networks across departments, and thrives in collaborative settings.

agreeableness.description: Listens attentively to input, mediates disagreements, and recognizes others' contributions publicly.

neuroticism.description: Remains calm under pressure and rarely expresses frustration openly.

collectivism.description: Values team cohesion and often frames goals in terms of shared success.

hierarchy_preference.description: Prefers flat structures and open dialogue over rigid top-down directives.

shame_sensitivity.description: Handles setbacks openly and encourages learning from mistakes without assigning blame.

conflict_tolerance.description: Comfortably addresses disagreements but steers conversations back to common goals.

uncertainty_avoidance.description: Balances risk with thoughtful planning, open to calculated experimentation.

traits: enthusiastically spotlights team wins in meetings
offers metaphors to simplify new strategies
draws out quieter team members for input
quickly brainstorms alternatives when plans stall
openly credits colleagues for innovative steps
encourages candid feedback even from junior staff
frames challenges as opportunities for learning
jokes lightly to diffuse tense moments
restates big-picture goals in simple terms
asks follow-up questions to clarify ideas
rarely shows irritation even in setbacks
frequently connects people from different departments

big_five.openness: Rafael is highly imaginative and always eager to experiment with new tools and concepts.
big_five.conscientiousness: He keeps team efforts organized, balancing structure with creative freedom.
big_five.extraversion: He energizes group discussions and enjoys building relationships both inside and outside his team.
big_five.agreeableness: He is empathetic, routinely diffuses disagreements, and ensures credit is shared.
big_five.neuroticism: He maintains composure under stress and rarely lets negative emotions affect his leadership.

style.communication: Rafael speaks with animated enthusiasm, often using simple analogies and inclusive language to engage the group. He invites input from all levels and makes a point of showing genuine excitement when others contribute valuable ideas.
style.mannerisms: Gestures with open palms and expressive hands, leans forward when listening, and makes frequent eye contact. He often nods encouragingly and occasionally laughs softly to lighten the mood.
style.decision-making: He gathers input broadly, synthesizes team insights, and announces decisions with a focus on shared rationale and next steps. Often, he frames his choices as group victories or collective experiments.

long_term_goals: Launch three market-leading digital products in five years
Grow and mentor the next generation of product innovators
Position Votorantim as a reference in digital transformation in Latin America
Foster a workplace culture where experimentation is celebrated
Expand his knowledge by collaborating with international tech hubs
Balance professional ambition with time for family and travel
